learnIsland.title: Why we fight.
learnIsland.description: You enter a harsh and mysterious island, filled with untold dangers and hidden treasures. To survive and thrive here, you must learn to navigate its challenges and harness its resources.

islandTopics.title: The Temple of the Mortal Throne
islandTopics.description: The centre stage of this conflict. The Temple of the Mortal Throne is a massive structure that houses the seat of power for whoever controls it. At it's peak lies the Mortal Throne itself,
